name: Savings rUSD
oneLiner: srUSD is Reservoir's savings wrapper of rUSD; share price accrues yield from RWA, lending vaults, and credit strategies on the Reservoir balance sheet.
collateral: Yield-bearing Reservoir savings token backed by the Reservoir balance sheet: stablecoin PSM liquidity, RWA allocations, Morpho/Euler lending vaults, and governance-approved credit strategies monitored through Reservoir's on-chain proof-of-reserves endpoint
pegMechanism: srUSD accrues protocol yield against rUSD. Holders can exit srUSD to rUSD, while rUSD is minted and redeemed through Reservoir's PSM against supported stablecoins subject to protocol liquidity and risk controls.

blacklistabilityReview.evidence: Direct Ethereum route: verified 0x738d1115b90efa71ae468f1287fc864775e23a31 is the immutable Savingcoin implementation documented in Reservoir's official repository. At Ethereum block 25535628, its DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE was held by EOA 0xb7570e32ded63b25163369d5eb4d8e89e70e5602 and its MINTER role by Savings Module 0x5475611dffb8ef4d697ae39df9395513b6e947d7; both EIP-1967 slots were zero. The source permits MINTER issuance and the admin can grant or revoke that role, but it has no blacklist, freeze, pause, seizure, or transfer-hook function. burnFrom follows ERC-20 allowance: an arbitrary-address, one-unit simulation reverted for insufficient allowance, while zero-value transfer and transferFrom simulations returned true. Direct Berachain route: verified 0x5475611dffb8ef4d697ae39df9395513b6e947d7 is a non-proxy SrusdOft deployment. At Berachain block 23537440, owner() returned the same EOA, msgInspector() was zero, token() returned the contract itself, its endpoint was 0x6f475642a6e85809b1c36fa62763669b1b48dd5b, both EIP-1967 slots were zero, and zero-value transfer and transferFrom simulations returned true. Its owner can change LayerZero peer, options, inspector, or ownership, which can affect cross-chain send routing, but verified OFT source has no local holder blacklist, pause, seizure, or transfer restriction; this is a future route-control surface, not a current local-balance control. Reservoir's terms impose interface eligibility and suspension conditions, not an on-chain holder-control function. The live transparency API was reviewed and continues to expose the rUSD balance sheet, including USDC and USD1 positions. Inherited route: srUSD remains a claim on rUSD, whose separately reviewed PSM and reserve exposure remains upstream; no direct override is authored to suppress it. The archive record preserves the reviewed product documentation snapshot.

reserveReview.rationale: srUSD is the savings passthrough on the same Reservoir balance sheet the live reservoir adapter reads, so the prior single rUSD wrapper slice is restated on the adapter's exact constituent identities. The Reservoir raw reserves API fetched on 2026-07-20 reported $35,933,768.81 of total assets across 11 rows; bucketing rows through the reviewed Reservoir adapter mapping yields Hastra/Sentora PRIME 45.0%, Pendle PT-USDat-27AUG2026 25.4%, Aave GHO on Plasma/Monad 15.4%, USDC (direct/PSM plus Morpho Steakhouse Prime Instant V2) 9.5%, USD1 (direct plus Morpho Steakhouse High Yield USD1) 2.1%, and the unmapped Agua Global Carry Vault 2.6%; rounded slices sum to 100.0%. Risk-tier judgment calls mirror the rUSD review: PRIME stays high as Figure-originated HELOC private credit; PT USDat stays high as a fixed-maturity Pendle principal token (matures 2026-08-27) with AMM-exit basis risk; the Agua vault remains unmapped because Reservoir discloses no constituent breakdown.
reserveReview.compositionBasis: Reservoir raw reserves API (app.reservoir.xyz/api/reserves/raw) fetched 2026-07-20; totalBalanceValue rows bucketed through the reviewed Reservoir live-reserve adapter mapping and normalized against totalAssets $35,933,768.81; srUSD is a savings passthrough on this same balance sheet
reserveReview.knownUnknownExposure: The 2.6% Agua Global Carry Vault row (multi-strategy ERC-4626 across lending markets, protocols, and chains) does not expose a constituent-level allocation that supports a tracked-stablecoin mapping.

providers.name: Reservoir Protocol on-chain Asset Adapter / PSM contracts (self-custodied balance sheet; no third-party custodian)

custodyProfile.reviewer: Kimi P2 reserve cohort rc-7 (lead tusd-trueusd)
custodyProfile.uncertainty: srUSD shares the rUSD custody boundary: Reservoir's balance sheet sits in protocol-controlled Asset Adapter and PSM contracts, and neither the Terms of Service (2024-08-23) nor any docs.reservoir.xyz page reviewed today names a third-party custodian, trust, SPV, or holder claim on reserve assets, so no bankruptcy-remoteness structure is documented. Reserve re-use is the protocol's core yield model, and protocol admins can reallocate the balance sheet without holder consent; custody of the underlying Figure HELOC collateral for the PRIME sleeve sits upstream with Hastra/Democratized Prime. No named legal issuer entity is disclosed (Cayman Islands governing law only), so holder recourse in an insolvency is untested.
